author: Creator
identifyAfterLogin: After signing in or verifying, identify the creator again.
removeHint: Stops checking this creator and removes subscription updates. Downloaded files are kept.
addHint: Paste a Bilibili, Douyin or YouTube creator profile link.
baselineHint: Existing works are recorded when you subscribe. Notifications start with later updates.
emptyHint: Add a creator profile to be notified about new works.
noUpdatesHint: New works will appear here when creators publish.
noMatchHint: Try a different creator, platform or keyword.
automaticHint: Checks all enabled creators in sequence on one shared schedule.
intervalHint: All subscriptions join the same round. The default is one round every 24 hours.
systemNotificationsHint: Combines multiple works from one creator into one notification.
lifecycleHint: Checks continue in the tray and stop when the app quits. Due subscriptions are checked after startup or wake.
backfillHint: Catching up in batches. The next pass starts in one minute.

errors.profileUrl: Paste a Bilibili, Douyin or YouTube creator profile link.
errors.channelId: Could not identify the YouTube channel ID. Try its channel profile link.
errors.listingUnavailable: Could not read this creator's works. Check the sign-in state or try again later.
errors.duplicate: You are already subscribed to this creator.
errors.candidateExpired: The preview expired. Identify the creator again.
errors.contentType: Choose content types supported by this platform.
errors.timeout: The check timed out. Try again later.
errors.pageLimit: The catch-up pagination limit was reached.
